OpenRiC mapping (spec v0.61.0): openricx:hasDateRangeSet, expanding in RDF to rico:hasCreationDate, hasBeginningDate, hasEndDate
Rationale: A deliberate API shape (Provenance and Event Q4) with a stated expansion to RiC-O.

Name: Level of description
RiC-AG 0.1 (RiC-CM): attr: Record Set Type
OpenRiC mapping (spec v0.61.0): Level drives the class; rico:hasRecordSetType on a RecordSet
Rationale: The level goes out as rico:hasRecordSetType, RiC-AG's Record Set Type. Choosing Record, Record Set or Record Part from the level (section 6.1) is a default for data from ISAD(G) systems, which hold only a level; RiC-AG leaves the choice to context, and nothing in the mapping stops an implementation from making it otherwise.
